eternity.line: Those tributes to finality, to eternity
stanza: Well, I looked at the granite markers
Those tributes to finality, to eternity
And then I looked at myself here
Chicken scratching for my immortality

eternity.line: You and I could see into the same eternity
stanza: You and I could see into the same eternity
Every second brimming with a majesty

eternity.line: But the lord has sent me eternity
eternity.linePrev: Now it's all I can afford
eternity.lineNext: It's to save the little children

eternity.line: We've got tonight, we've got eternity
stanza: We've got tonight, we've got eternity
You got me taking my time
We took a look and we was guaranteed
You've got the rest of my life
You've got the rest of my life

eternity.line: From her to eternity
stanza: From her to eternity
From her to eternity
From her to eternity

eternity.line: Every breath he takes, eternity
stanza: Can you see the wise man simply living, loving quietly?
Every breath he takes, eternity

eternity.line: Fire from eternity
stanza: Every day's a lesson in giving away
Stripes on my floor
Dark shots at my door
Have you ever walked in on a queen before?
I just went through the valley
I know it's changed me
Fire from eternity
The origin of my dreams

eternity.line: And in the lonely chanting of the sea, I heard the echoes of eternity
stanza: I had a little boat
I called it Life
I went out and never came back
All of a sudden, there was a big wind
And waves like mountains
Many things raced through my mind
And in the lonely chanting of the sea, I heard the echoes of eternity
And in the fantasy of cloud and sky, I saw The One Who Lives
While all things die
And I was swallowed by the sea
And lost in the deep
And washed up on the shore

eternity.line: Rosabel believe, not even Eternity —
stanza: Him and I in the room
To prove you are with us too
He's using code that only you and I know
This is no trick of his
This is your magic
I'd catch the queues, watching you
Hoping you'd do something wrong
Everybody thinks you'll never make it —
But every time you escape,
Rosabel believe, not even Eternity —
Can hold Houdini
"Rosabel, believe!"

eternity.line: Free to spend eternity
stanza: Mr. Hades set you free
To work yourself into the ground
Free to spend eternity

eternity.line: Goodness eternity
stanza: Goodness her, goodness me
Goodness eternity
Out you go, in you be
Dried roses

eternity.line: From the shores of eternity
Stars climb eternity
And took him down the road to eternity
stanza: Little James Dean, up on the screen
Wondering who he might be
Along came a Spyder and picked up a rider
And took him down the road to eternity

eternity.line: Wait awhile, eternity
stanza: Wait awhile, eternity
Old mother nature's got nothing on me
Come to me, run to me, come to me now
We're rolling, my sweetheart, we're flowing, by God

eternity.line: To protect you for all eternity
stanza: The blood of God is my defence
Let it drip down to my seed
Showers to your innocence
To protect you for all eternity
And with this wood I beat this drum
And we won't see defeat
From kings and queens becomes a prince
Knowledge and wisdom is understanding what we need

eternity.line: I promise I will love her until eternity
stanza: Now, Cupid, if your arrow make her love strong for me
I promise I will love her until eternity
I know between the two of us, her heart we can steal
Help me if you will
So

eternity.line: All together for eternity
stanza: But I can't help it now
Looking for faces in the clouds
I've got some friends I barely see
But we're all planning to meet
We'll lay in bags as dead as leaves
All together for eternity

eternity.line: I am yours forever more (Ever more), 'til eternity
stanza: Baby please (Baby please), please don't take your love from me
(Please don't take your love from me)
I am yours forever more (Ever more), 'til eternity
Silently (So silently), listen to the words I say
(Listen to the words I say)
I'm not talking just for play (Just for play), listen to me please
(Won't you listen to me)

eternity.line: It's an eternity
stanza: Oh baby it's a hard way
It's an eternity
Got the life that we wanted
Not the love that we need

eternity.line: With one brave historic act, I will win your love, now and for all eternity
stanza: My dearest Jodie,​
I am humiliated by my weakness and my impotence
But Jodie, I can change
I'll prove to you that I can change
With one brave historic act, I will win your love, now and for all eternity
Love, John

eternity.line: For she fears that one will ask her for eternity
stanza: She has brought them to her senses
They have laughed inside her laughter
Now she rallies her defenses
For she fears that one will ask her for eternity
And she's so busy being free

eternity.line: That doesn't really matter next to eternity
stanza: In two days it's my birthday and I'll be thirty-three
That doesn't really matter next to eternity
But I like a double number, and I like an odd one too
And everything I see from now on will be somethin' new

eternity.songTitle: The Man with the Child in His Eyes
eternity.line: All his love, till eternity
stanza: And suddenly I find myself
Listening to a man I've never known before
Telling me about the sea
All his love, till eternity
